# Measured weights for the internal/coreutils shards, in seconds.
#
# `TestName seconds` per line; `#` comments and blanks ignored. A name with no
# entry weighs 1, so this file steers BALANCE only — it can never drop a test
# or run one twice, because scripts/shard-tests partitions the live list and
# every listed name lands in exactly one bucket. A stale weight costs an
# unevenly filled shard, nothing more.
#
# Two lists, partitioned separately, because `go test -run` splits its pattern
# on `/` before applying each part to a level: `^(TestCatParity|TestX/cat)$` is
# not a valid mixed selector, so a shard selects whole top-level tests in one
# invocation and its slice of TestSelfHostCoreutilsParity in another.
#
# Weight-1 entries are omitted — the partitioner already defaults to one.
# Source: a full `go test -v ./internal/coreutils/` run, 2026-09-21. Refresh
# with the same method when the spread drifts; see docs/CI-WEIGHT-REFRESH.md
# for the multi-run rules the self-host table follows.
